metadata.title: Kinematics of High-Velocity Stars Utilizing LAMOST and Gaia DR3 Archives within 100 kpc

notes: None. The paper analyzes three aggregate high-velocity samples (T:p3-b0; 591, 87, and 519) and reports group kinematics; it does not identify individual stars as Galactic unbound candidates. Program I's stated velocity selection is V_GSR > 445 km/s (T:p4-b1), not an escape-velocity/unbound criterion. Program II's "ejected from the galactic center" (T:p5-b1) is an origin statement, and Program III is described only as HiVels influenced by the LMC potential (T:p5-b2). HVS23 is expressly omitted from Program II because it lacks a Gaia DR3 identification and proper motions (T:p5-b1), so it is not analyzed and its label alone does not establish candidacy. The visible Gaia DR3 rows in Table 1 (I:p6-b0) provide only coordinates and radial velocities, not individual unbound assessments.
